A LITTLE ABOUT ME

Intentional design.
Endless curiosity.

I’m Leo Battiste, a product designer connecting brands, products, and the people who use them.

LEO BATTISTE / PRODUCT DESIGNER

A person behind the pixels.

I work across brand and product, connecting the way something looks with the way it works. I’m interested in thoughtful digital experiences that help people discover, explore, and connect.

My work on Pheelm spans the name and logo through to the digital experience. It brings together the parts of design I care about: a clear idea, a considered identity, and a product people can explore.

This space is also home to my ongoing collection of tools and references. The Toolbox is a way to share useful things I’ve found along the way.

HOW I THINK ABOUT DESIGN

Consider the whole.
Care for the details.

01

Make room for clarity.

Help people understand where they are, what matters, and what they can do next.

02

Connect brand and product.

Let the idea behind a product show up in its identity and in the experience of using it.

03

Stay curious.

Keep exploring tools, references, and different ways of approaching a design problem.
